clips.title: The story
paras: Outside Northshire Abbey, Drusilla La Salle teaches warlocks in the graveyard. The human trainer works beyond the Holy Order’s reach, guiding new spellcasters in shadow and summoning. When forbidden knowledge leaves the abbey, she moves to claim it.

Drusilla La Salle teaches novice warlocks among the headstones outside Northshire Abbey. Paladins and priests practice beneath the abbey’s stained glass, while warlocks keep to society’s edges because demonology and fel magic are taboo in Stormwind. Recruits receive tainted correspondence before Drusilla shows them how to wield shadow power without drawing the abbey authorities’ immediate anger.
